tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_shadow_wave_: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.

Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_dazzle_nothl_projec: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_dazzle_bio:
Each young acolyte to the Dezun order must complete a series of rites before becoming a shadow priest. The final rite, the rite of shades, is a harrowing spiritual journey through the Nothl Realm, an unpredictable domain from which not all visitants return. Of those who do, some return mad. Others return with strange aptitudes. But all who go there are changed by their experiences.

Driven by the need for enlightenment, Dazzle was the youngest of his tribe ever to request the sacred ritual. At first the order refused him, saying he was too young. But Dazzle was not to be dissuaded. Sensing something special in the headstrong young acolyte, the elders relented. Dazzle drank down the sacred potion and sat by the fire while the rest of his tribe danced through the night.

In this ethereal dimension of the Nothl Realm, the properties of light and dark are inverted. Thus his brilliant healing light, beautiful to our eye, is actually a sinister kind of evil; and the darkest deeds are done in a dazzling glow. The elders' intuition was prophetic: Dazzle returned to his people as a Shadow Priest like none seen before, with the power to heal as well as to destroy. Now he uses his gift to cut down his enemies and mend his friends.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_dazzle_hype: Born to support his cohorts in battle, Dazzle keeps wounded allies alive so they might later rain death upon the enemy. His strange magic weaves its way into nearby armor, weakening enemies and strengthening friends.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_dazzle_npedesc1: Powerful healer who can briefly prevent death

fields.name: buff1text
fields.value: Shallow Grave: Protected by Voodoo! You cannot be killed while under this effect!

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability effects are applied as follows:
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Code|dazzle_shallow_grave}}
*#* Reapplying the buff refreshes its duration.
*#* Considers {{M|clones}}, {{M|illusions}}, and {{M|creep-heroes}} as heroes.
*#* {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*#** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability on Dazzle.
*#* Grants the following bonuses upon cast: 
*#** Set the affected unit's [[min health]] and prevents the affected unit from reaching below {{Symbol|Health}} {{#var:Shallow Grave value1}} [[health]].
*#*** Neither affects nor [[Damage Manipulation|manipulate]] the incoming damage instance value.
*#*** Procs {{M|on-damage effects}} as per normal.
*#*** This effectively prevents {{M|death}} and from dying to the following sources:
*#**** {{A|Ancient Apparition|Ice Blast}}'s kill threshold.
*#**** {{A|Oracle|False Promise}}'s delayed damage.
*#**** {{M|Instant kill}} sources applied to {{M|illusions}}.
*#*** Does not protect the allied unit from the following sources:
*#**** {{A|Axe|Culling Blade}}'s kill threshold.
*#**** {{M|Forced kill}} sources.
*#**** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{A|Wraith King|Reincarnation|text=Wraith Delay}} expiring.
*#** {{Symbol|a|up}}
*#*** Grants {{#var:Shallow Grave value3}} {{Symbol|bonus ampin-p}} incoming {{M|heal}} amplification per {{#var:Shallow Grave value2}} max health missing.
*#*** Checks the health percentage per {{M|server tick}} and adapts its bonus values immediately.
*#**** {{cf|expr}}
*#***** {{Code|When Max[[Health|HP]] ≥ 91% , f(HealAmp) {{=}} 0}}
*#***** {{Code|When MaxHP < 3%  , f(HealAmp) {{=}} {{calc|1+v1*10|v1={{#var:Shallow Grave value3}}}}}}
*#* {{Symbol|Dispel|Death}}
*#** The buff can be [[dispelled]] by the following sources:
*#*** {{M|Death}}
*#*** {{A|Phoenix|Supernova}} and its {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}}.
*# {{Symbol|bonus hprestore}}
*#* Applies the {{A|Dazzle|Nothl Projection}} end [[heal]] component the affected unit upon losing the buff in any way. 
*#** Hence, the incoming heal amplification component of Shallow Grave does not affect the heal value for this ability component.

fields.name: lore
fields.value: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Sends a wave of power that bounces between and heals all affected allied units.

Shadow Wave always heals the Shadow Priest, without counting toward the number of bounces upon cast.

fields.name: desc1
fields.value: Deals damage to enemy units within the radius of the wave.

fields.name: desc2
fields.value:
Has a reduced cooldown while the projection is active.

This ability component levels up with {{A|Dazzle|Nothl Projection}}.

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Enable casting Shadow Wave on enemy units, with all ability effects centering and unit-targeted enemy akin to an allied unit cast.

fields.name: desc4
fields.value: Dazzle instant attacks all affected enemy units that the wave comes in contact with.

fields.name: interacts
mechanics
fields.value:
* Has the following targeting functionalities: 
** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{to}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} or {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** When unit-targeted, applies all ability effects centered around the unit.
*** {{cf|aghnotes}} Enables Shadow Wave casting on enemy units.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** {{M|Doubletap}} casts the ability and applies all ability effects centered around Dazzle.

* The ability has two main components:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|1|21px]]
*** The ability effects are applied as follows:
***# {{Symbol|bonus agh}} The {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} on affected enemy units within the radius.
***# {{Symbol|bonus agh}} The {{M|heal}} on affected allied units.
***# The heal on affected allied units.
***# The physical spell damage on affected enemy units within the radius.
***# {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Attack Damage|Instant}}
***#* Launches an [[instant attack]] projectile toward all {{M|spell damage}}-affected enemy units within the radius, with the following properties:
***#** Procs any {{M|attack modifiers}} and {{M|on-hit effects}} as per normal.
***#** Does not have {{M|True Strike}}.
***#** Affected by {{M|disarm}} sources.
***#* Affects the following units:
***#** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***#* Does not affect the following units:
***#** Other non-unit-targeted enemy units.
***#** {{M|Invisible}} units.
***#** {{U|Undying Zombie|text=Undying Zombies}}.
***#** {{M|Ward-type units}}.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|2|21px]]
*** {{M|Heals}} and deals {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} to all affected allied and enemy units respectively, and simutaneously upon cast.
*** Hence, each heal instance and spell damage instance applies {{Symbol|Modifier|Buff}} {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{A|Dazzle|Weave}} of its corresponding level according to the ability effects sequence.
**** Has the following priority accordingly to all affected units' {{M|current health}}:
***** Low [[Health|HP]] Heroes {{to}} Low HP Creeps / Full HP Heroes {{to}} Full HP Creeps
****** The lowest health unit is always affected first according to the priority.
****** If multiple units of the same priority has the same amount of health, the ability effects are applied between them randomly.
****** Considers {{M|clones}} and the {{H|Spirit Bear}} as heroes, {{M|illusions}} and other {{M|creep-heroes}} as creeps.
****** {{cf|aghnotes}} The {{M|Aghanim's Scepter|text=ability upgrade}} also utilizes the aforementioned health priority mechanic.
**** {{Symbol|Target|Area-Dummy}} {{Symbol|Affect|Ally}} or {{Symbol|bonus agh}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
***** The damage radius is centered around per healed allied unit or {{ValueColor||per damaged enemy unit|agh}}.
***** {{Symbol|Target|Area-inter}}
****** Multiple overlapping Shadow Wave damage radius stack.
***** Affects the following units:
****** {{M|Fogged units}}.
****** {{M|Invisible}} units.
****** {{M|Untargetable}} units.
**** Considers the following units as valid units:
***** {{M|Couriers}}
***** {{M|Invulnerable}} units.
****** The {{M|heal}} bounce affects invulnerable units, despite being unable to directly {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} target the unit.
**** Does not consider the following units as valid units:
***** {{M|Spell immune}} units.
***** {{M|Ward-type units}}.

fields.value: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
The Priest projects his Shadow in a short distance away, and stuns his own physical body for the duration.

After the effect ends, the Shadow forcefully returns and applies a Strong Dispel onto the Priest.

The Shadow is an untargetable and invulnerable clone of Dazzle.

It survives till the end of the ability effects or until Dazzle is killed.

fields.name: desc2

fields.name: desc3
fields.value: Heals the affected allied unit upon losing the Shallow Grave buff in any way.

fields.value: Shadow Wave has an increased cooldown reduction when cast by the Shadow Projection.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
** Has the following clone {{M|projectile speed|text=return speeds}}, whichever is faster:
**# [[File:Dazzle End Projection abilityicon dota2 gameasset.png|21px|End Projection]] {{to}} {{hi|Dazzle}} at {{#var:End Projection value1}}-speed.
**# [[File:Dazzle End Projection abilityicon dota2 gameasset.png|21px|End Projection]] {{to}} {{hi|Dazzle}} in {{#var:End Projection value2}} seconds.
** Hence, the Shadow Clone returns even faster when the distance between both Dazzle and the clone is {{Code|≥ {{#expr:{{#var:End Projection value1}}*{{#var:End Projection value2}}}}-distance}}.

abilities: Shallow Grave keeps an ally un-killable for a few seconds, denying a guaranteed kill.
Dazzle is squishy, so he must be locked down before he casts Shallow Grave.
items: Linken's Sphere blocks Dazzle's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Dazzle's magic damage and disables.
Spirit Vessel cuts Dazzle's healing and regeneration.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Dazzle's targeted disable.
Glimmer Cape's magic resistance and fade help dodge Dazzle's burst.
Armor manipulation to amplify a target.
A team heal, mana, and dispel in one.
A clutch save when you get bursted.

sourceRecord: Shallow Grave keeps an ally un-killable for a few seconds, denying a guaranteed kill.
Dazzle is squishy, so he must be locked down before he casts Shallow Grave.
Linken's Sphere blocks Dazzle's key single-target spell.
Black King Bar's spell immunity ignores Dazzle's magic damage and disables.
Spirit Vessel cuts Dazzle's healing and regeneration.
Lotus Orb reflects and dispels Dazzle's targeted disable.
Glimmer Cape's magic resistance and fade help dodge Dazzle's burst.
Armor manipulation to amplify a target.
A team heal, mana, and dispel in one.
A clutch save when you get bursted.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_dazzle
data.bio_loc:
Each young acolyte to the Dezun order must complete a series of rites before becoming a shadow priest. The final rite, the rite of shades, is a harrowing spiritual journey through the Nothl Realm, an unpredictable domain from which not all visitants return. Of those who do, some return mad. Others return with strange aptitudes. But all who go there are changed by their experiences.

Driven by the need for enlightenment, Dazzle was the youngest of his tribe ever to request the sacred ritual. At first the order refused him, saying he was too young. But Dazzle was not to be dissuaded. Sensing something special in the headstrong young acolyte, the elders relented. Dazzle drank down the sacred potion and sat by the fire while the rest of his tribe danced through the night.

In this ethereal dimension of the Nothl Realm, the properties of light and dark are inverted. Thus his brilliant healing light, beautiful to our eye, is actually a sinister kind of evil; and the darkest deeds are done in a dazzling glow. The elders' intuition was prophetic: Dazzle returned to his people as a Shadow Priest like none seen before, with the power to heal as well as to destroy. Now he uses his gift to cut down his enemies and mend his friends.
data.hype_loc: Born to support his cohorts in battle, Dazzle keeps wounded allies alive so they might later rain death upon the enemy. His strange magic weaves its way into nearby armor, weakening enemies and strengthening friends.
data.npe_desc_loc: Powerful healer who can briefly prevent death

abilities.name: dazzle_poison_touch
abilities.desc_loc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
abilities.lore_loc: One of the few Dezun rites used for offensive purposes, the paralytic enchantment often proves useful.
notes_loc: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

abilities.name: dazzle_shallow_grave
abilities.desc_loc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
abilities.lore_loc: Only a seasoned acolyte of the Shadow can properly perform the rite of preventing death.
notes_loc: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

abilities.name: dazzle_shadow_wave
abilities.desc_loc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
abilities.lore_loc: While it is a simplistic and routine rite among Shadow Priests, the Shadow Wave is also the most critical for success.
notes_loc: If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
abilities.scepter_loc: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to %scepter_heal_pct%%% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

abilities.name: dazzle_innate_weave
abilities.desc_loc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
abilities.lore_loc: His ethereal journey into the Nothl realm has allowed Dazzle to mend together the powers of light and dark, creating shifting waves of enchantments.
abilities.shard_loc: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for %ally_heal% per stack of Weave.
facets_loc: Weave applies %ally_multiplier%x stacks to allies. Weave amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle by %heal_amplification_pct%%% per stack.

abilities.name: dazzle_nothl_projection
abilities.desc_loc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
abilities.lore_loc: The allure of the Nothl Realm is intoxicating, but Dazzle never forgets his purpose for being there.
notes_loc: When Dazzle's spirit is further than %leash_start% units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
abilities.shard_loc: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.
